name: Template
description: Copy this folder, rename it, fill every field. One line on the look and what it is best for.
rules: One accent colour, used for the single most important word or number per shot.
typography: Sans headlines, italic serif accent word, mono labels.
audio_direction: upbeat bed, soft pops and ticks, no loud effects
pitfalls: Text over busy images without a plate.
native_moves: the two or three moves this medium does best, e.g. a whip pan between two faces
